text: The Gazette of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
(Published by Authority) PART III — LANDS
Land Acquisition Notices
ශී ලංකා පජාතාන්තික සමාජවාදී ජනරජෙය් ගැසට් පතය අති විෙශෂ
No. 1912/6 – TUESDAY, APRIL 28, 2015
EXTRAORDINARY
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)

Notice under Section 7 I hereby give notice under Sub-section (1) of Section 07 of the Land Acquisition Act as amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964, that the Government intends to acquire the following land/servitude which is required for a public purpose:-
Description of the land or servitude to be acquired:

The following four of land, situated in Divisional Secretariat Division of Walallawita in the District of Kalutara in Western Province show as Lot Nos. 2544, 2545, 2547 and 2548 Supplementary No. 94 depicted in Final Village Plan No. 112 made by Surveyor General and situated in the Village of Pelawatta:—
Lot No. 2544
Name of the Land: Demodara Gan Kanda Pita Kattiya; Description: Road; Claimant: Kusumpala Walakulu-arachchi and D. C. Walakuluarachchi; Extent: 0.0025 Hectare.
Lot No. 2545
Name of the Land: Demodara Gan Kanda Pita Kattiya; Description : Road; Claimant: H. D. Gamini; Extent: 0.0120 Hectare.

Lot No. 2547 Name of the Land: Demodara Gan Kanda Pita Kattiya; Description: Home Garden; Claimant: D. C. Walakuluarachchi; Extent: 0.0077 Hectare. Lot No. 2548 Name of the Land: Demodara Gan Kanda Pita Kattiya; Description: Home Garden; Claimant: H. D. Gamini; Extent: 0.0011 Hectare. All persons interested in the aforesaid land/lands on which a servitude is to be acquired, are hereby required to appear personally, or by agents duly authorized in writing, before me at the Divisional Secretariat of Walallawita on the 10th June, 2015 at 10.30 a.m. and are hereby required to notify to me in writing (in duplicate) on or before the 03rd June, 2015 describing the nature of the land, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquitsition of the said land/servitude, the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount.
L. L. D. THILAKARATHNA, Divisional Secretary (Acting), Walallawita. Divisional Secretary’s Office, Walallawita. 27th March 2015. 05-287
